limits: Uploaded SL/skill/selection unknown; outcomes observational, no causal benefit or human-authorship proof.
Each repeated opportunity/combat and each uploaded-run denominator is separately reported; no independent-player denominator.
Act indices/point order are recorded sequence only; no exact global floor invented.
prefix_definition: Prior picked reward cards only, in recorded node order. Starting deck, removals, transforms, event/shop cards and upgrades unavailable: this is a reward-acquisition prefix proxy, NOT the actual decision-time full deck. Same-node picks are added only after all choices at that node.

aggregate_support_filter.scope: A minimum support data-volume filter, not evidence of efficacy or confidence; low-support cells missing from learner input cannot be called zero. All-run cohort denominator unchanged.
